svg.text: Two conditional models of an agent-driven information economy
Illustrative assumptions, not forecast. Independent modules; no fitted data or coupled equilibrium.
More entry dissipates rents; this model does not imply universal loss.
q = usable stock / (usable stock + noisy stock)
The noise-instability threshold depends on verification: A_c=4.5 at v=0.2; A_c=12 at v=0.6.
Changing the assumed creation, amplification or removal mechanisms changes these outcomes.
